category.name: additions
category.entry: independent snapshot state for unreleased versions within a development phase
configuration-driven development channels such as prealpha, alpha, beta, and early access
phase formatter support for channel-prefixed versions such as alpha-1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
phase-entry events that can reset numeric versions when promoting to a new channel

category.name: refactorings
category.entry: numeric increments now return to the configured initial development phase as snapshots
release operations now clear snapshot state without changing the numeric version or development channel
next-phase operations now apply configured phase transitions and entry events

category.name: additions
category.entry: configuration support for initial and release phase roles
